name: Quote generation - single sheet order
description: Customer requests a quote for a very small order of 1 sheet. AI should use generate_quote, return total and PDF link.

messages.text: My name is Test Customer, can I get a quote for 1 sheet of white melamine 16mm

expected_behaviors.description: Reply should contain a quote total with R prefix
Quote should be generated (quote_total populated or PDF URL in reply)
Quote generation may take up to 30 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply
No internal optimizer variable names in reply

notes: Edge case: minimum quantity of 1 sheet. Verifies quote generation works for single-sheet orders.
